notes.title: Deluxe Edition
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Negligee will be released with an optional Deluxe Edition, which will include all DLC content in a reduced priced package.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22700973/1ce41e7e3f5bb53c5f670233b3be1f17e4bac1e8.png[/img]

The six DLC packs when purchased as part of the Deluxe edition will players a discount on the full content offered.

N.b.
The Soundtrack, Wallpapers, Avatars and Dakimakuras will be available on release. The Walk-through and Companion Art-book will be released on the 27th October. All content packs will be automatically granted to anyone who purchases the Deluxe Edition.
